svg.text: How dx-maps is built: one owner per plugin, one merge at a time

text.textPath: shared library/ (@map) · every plugin in one place

svg.text: one shepherd: every agent talks to it; it orders the merges;
a repo agent per repo runs its branches and watches the work
one agent per plugin, in its own branch · the repo agent reads every change
pilot lock — one at a time
How a change joins the pilot — one at a time, so many plugins can be built at once
in its own branch and copy;
in the lock: merge the pilot,
moves only when a person approves,
after full checks on that version
landing (main) → ONE build → one web folder → three outputs
the pilot server follows development · the landing server rebuilds from main
the same folder, wrapped by Capacitor
the same folder, wrapped by Tauri
At scale: many people × many agents × many plugins
one PR branch per plugin or feature → joins the pilot through the lock → previewed on the pilot server
in the cloud: a self-hosted git service, because an agent can publish by accident
publish to a public host only from landing (main), when it is ready
